items.source: Apply the containing ApplicationContext's lifecycle methods to the given View instance, if such a context is available.
items.translation: 如果存在这样的上下文，则将包含的ApplicationContext的生命周期方法应用于给定的View实例。

items.source: Return the name of the RequestContext attribute for all views, if any.
items.translation: 返回所有视图的 `RequestContext` 属性名称（如果有）。

items.translation: 返回此 ViewResolver 可处理的视图名称（或名称模式）。

items.source: URL based RedirectView provider which can be used to provide, for example, redirect views with a custom default status code.
items.translation: 基于 URL 的RedirectView 提供者，可用于提供例如带有自定义默认状态码的重定向视图。

items.source: Set the name of the RequestContext attribute for all views.
items.translation: 为所有视图设置 `RequestContext` 属性的名称。

items.source: Supports AbstractUrlBasedView subclasses like FreeMarkerView. The view class for all views generated by this resolver can be specified via the "viewClass" property.
items.translation: 支持 `AbstractUrlBasedView` 的子类，例如 FreeMarkerView。 可以通过 "viewClass" 属性指定此解析器生成的所有视图的视图类。

items.source: To be used for the initialization of newly created View instances, applying lifecycle callbacks and providing access to the containing environment.
items.translation: 用于初始化新创建的View实例，应用生命周期回调并提供对包含环境的访问。

items.source: Spring lifecycle methods as defined by the bean container do not have to be called here: They will be automatically applied afterwards, provided that an ApplicationContext is available.
items.translation: 由 Bean 容器定义的 Spring 生命周期方法不必在此处调用：只要提供了 `ApplicationContext`，它们将在之后自动应用。

items.source: Does not perform any lookup for pre-defined View instances.
items.translation: not 不对预定义的 View 实例执行任何查找。

items.source:
View names can either be resource URLs themselves, or get augmented by a
specified prefix and/or suffix. Exporting an attribute that holds the
RequestContext to all views is explicitly supported.
items.translation: 视图名称可以是资源 URL 本身，也可以通过指定的前缀和/或后缀进行增强。显式支持向所有视图导出包含 RequestContext 的属性。

items.source:
As a special feature, redirect URLs can be specified via the "redirect:"
prefix. For example: "redirect:myAction" will trigger a redirect to the given
URL, rather than resolution as standard view name. This is typically used
for redirecting to a controller URL after finishing a form workflow.
items.translation: 作为特殊功能，可以通过"redirect:"前缀指定重定向 URL。例如："redirect:myAction"将触发到给定 URL 的重定向，而不是像标准视图名称那样进行解析。这通常用于在完成表单工作流后重定向到控制器 URL。

items.source:
Note: This class does not support localized resolution, i.e. resolving
a symbolic view name to different resources depending on the current locale.
items.translation: 注意：该类不支持本地化解析，即根据当前区域设置将符号视图名称解析为不同资源。

items.source: Indicates whether this ViewResolver can handle the supplied view name. If not, an empty result is returned. The default implementation checks against the configured view names.
items.translation: 指示此ViewResolver是否可以处理提供的视图名称。如果不能，则返回空结果。默认实现会检查配置的视图名称。

items.source:
Prefix for special view names that specify a redirect URL (usually
to a controller after a form has been submitted and processed).
Such view names will not be resolved in the configured default
way but rather be treated as special shortcut.
items.translation: 用于指定重定向 URL 的特殊视图名称前缀（通常在表单提交并处理后重定向到控制器）。此类视图名称不会以配置的默认方式解析，而是被视为特殊快捷方式。
